_comment: The one list of connected tools (MCP servers). `default: true` are added by ./install. Others: ./install --mcp <name>. Entries with `env` prompt for the value if unset. playwright and postgres are undecided (audit 2026-11-16).

context7.why: Up-to-date library docs when picking up a new language or framework.

github.why: Pull requests, issues and CI status for code review and delivery. Uses your GitHub token.

playwright.why: Browser automation for front-end acceptance tests and onboarding-funnel checks.

postgres.why: Read-only database inspection for redundant-query and slow-query audits.
